selection.policy: explicit-relation natural question, exact answer span; one question per dialogue by hash
selection.history_order: target window then two other source-dialogue windows; preserve source turn order and source session identity within each window
selection.labels: upstream structured relation plus exact answer span; mechanically checked, agent-reviewed question fit; no independent human relevance claim

candidate_definitions.baseline: existing count-based cue seeds and unconditional bounded residual
candidate_definitions.reset: zero residual, diagnostic control, ineligible for production
candidate_definitions.idf: smoothed IDF lexical seed weights; existing residual budget
candidate_definitions.cue_gate: count seeds; residual budget multiplied by distribution overlap sum(min(normalized seed, normalized residual)); retain state when no seed evidence
candidate_definitions.cue_idf: IDF seeds plus full overlap gate
candidate_definitions.conservative: IDF seeds; residual budget multiplied by 0.5 + 0.5 * overlap, preserving a half-budget for implicit follow-ups
candidate_definitions.novel_cue: Count seeds unchanged. Among supported cue terms occurring in less than half of live fragments, retain residuals if at least half the smoothed-IDF cue information occurs in the six most active residual fragments; otherwise suppress residuals for this recall only. Retain state when no distinctive supported cue exists.

gates.selection: Select eligible candidate on music/dev by switch recall, then switch MRR, then candidate declaration order. Freeze development report before scoring film/test or music/test. No evaluation-based replacement.
gates.evaluation: Same guards on pooled official test cases; cold/followup recall must also not decrease in either domain. All existing regression, bounded activation, scope, provenance, applications, Witness and restore checks must pass before integration.

limitations: Small, relation-filtered two-domain factual recall study; does not establish general retrieval or model-response quality.
Original order/session identities are preserved within source windows; cross-dialogue chronology and replay timestamps are artificial.
Absent-evidence nonempty contexts measure context suppression, not answer abstention or hallucination.
No attachment-weight changes, clinical efficacy claims or human recruitment.
revision_reason: Development v1 rejected all candidates; add a focused novelty gate before any evaluation scoring. Sources, controls, thresholds and case selections unchanged.
